AnyAbility: Lowers to the activation filter Any.
AnyColor: Lowers to one protection per color, so the name only survives in the hexproof form.
AnySpellOrAbility: Lowers to ObjectFilter::Any over the stack.
DifferentNames: As a count, lowers to CountDistinct over Names.
EachBasicLandType: Lowers to one subtype filter per basic land type.
NonManaAbility: Lowers to the activation filter Not Mana.
RevealACardFromHandAtRandom: As a cost, lowers to CostPart::Reveal with random set.
TheChosenColor: Lowers to a chosen-color filter or mana, so the name only survives in rows.
XCantBeZero: Lowers to a casting requirement that X is greater than zero.
